title: Open Vessels Oklahoma City: Joey Chappell on Practical Care
summary: Joey Chappell of Open Vessels talks with his brother Jed about faith expressed through home repairs, practical care and showing up for neighbors in Oklahoma City. Drawing on family memories and work alongside people in recovery, he considers the difference between wanting appreciation and serving because a need is there. The conversation asks what sustained care looks like when a small organization has more requests than resources.
